y.title: Slowdown share against the race’s usual

method: 195 editions that pass the start-offset screen with 100 or more finishes and a weather row, in races with three or more such editions: each edition's sustained slowdown share and its warming over the four hours after the scheduled start, both against the race's own average, with the within-race start-temperature slope removed; editions grouped by warming more than 2 °C below the race's usual, 0.5–2 below, within 0.5, 0.5–2 above and 2 or more above, each edition counted once. Weather is edition context, never a personal exposure.
